payload.reason: The evidence specifies the datasets used during joint training for speculation detection and scope resolution tasks.

claims.text: The models were trained on multiple datasets including the BioScope Corpus (sub corpora BF and BA) and the SFU Review Corpus.
Joint training on these datasets improved performance compared to single dataset training.
The datasets used were BF (BioScope Full Papers), BA (BioScope Abstracts), and SFU (SFU Review Corpus).
